manifest_semantics.expected_suppressed.matches: Expected Valgrind used_suppression context count; ranges or per-scenario exact values are enforced.
manifest_semantics.expected_suppressed.bytes: Expected suppressed bytes; null means Valgrind does not emit a byte count for that finding type.

effective_inherited_sets.audit: Pinned wholesale because this is Ghostty's own regression suppression set. Duplicate rule names prevent name-only identity; hash, rule count, runtime usage, and the pinned Ghostty revision are therefore all checked.
Embedding-specific inherited rules cover loader metadata, Fontconfig, and GTK GIO initialization. The exact file is pinned and every used rule is retained in each report.
Valgrind built-in suppressions remain enabled in both raw and reviewed runs; raw means no Ghostty or Zentty suppression files, not --default-suppressions=no.

rules.rule_name: GTK SVG loader stripped librsvg undefined values
rules.affected: Ubuntu librsvg 2.58.0, GTK 4.14.5 GdkPixbuf SVG icon loading, Wayland or X11/Xwayland
rules.justification: The producer frame is the stripped external librsvg loader and the consumer terminates at gdk_pixbuf_loader_close; Ghostty frames are excluded from the rule.
rules.reproducer: GDK_BACKEND=wayland ZENTTY_MEMORY_SCENARIO=single linux/tests/memory-safety; compare its .raw.log and .suppressed.log receipts.

rules.affected: Ubuntu Fontconfig 2.15.0 and Pango 1.52.1 process-global metrics cache
rules.justification: The allocation begins in stripped Fontconfig and is consumed through the named Pango metrics API. Child rules are permitted only when this root is present in the same report.
rules.reproducer: linux/tests/ibus-focus-reproducer.c reproduces the root without linking Ghostty; linux/tests/ibus-focus-memory preserves raw and reviewed receipts.

rules.rule_name: GTK Pango Fontconfig metrics cache children
rules.affected: Ubuntu Fontconfig 2.15.0 indirect calloc children of the Pango metrics cache
rules.finding_type: Memcheck:Leak indirect children with pango_context_get_metrics consumer
rules.justification: Every frame includes both stripped Fontconfig and pango_context_get_metrics; usage must co-occur with the separately tracked root.
rules.reproducer: The non-Ghostty Pango/IBus reproducer yields 32 matches/1024 bytes beside two metrics roots; product X11 yields 16/512 beside one root.

rules.rule_name: GTK Pango Fontconfig metrics cache strings
rules.affected: Ubuntu Fontconfig 2.15.0 deep recursive string nodes owned by the Pango metrics cache
rules.justification: The prior one-frame Fontconfig rule was rejected. This rule now requires strdup followed by five consecutive stripped Fontconfig frames and is valid only beside the metrics root.
rules.reproducer: With 40-frame receipts, the non-Ghostty Pango/IBus reproducer records 18 matches/2962 bytes beside two explicitly requested metrics roots; product receipts have exact scenario baselines above.

rules.rule_name: GTK Pango Fontconfig metrics cache nodes
rules.affected: Ubuntu Fontconfig 2.15.0 deep recursive node graph owned by the Pango metrics cache
rules.justification: The prior malloc-plus-one-Fontconfig rule was rejected. This replacement requires eight consecutive stripped Fontconfig frames and root co-occurrence.
rules.reproducer: The non-Ghostty Pango/IBus reproducer records 1 match/4384 bytes beside two explicitly requested metrics roots; product receipts record 5728-11456 bytes.

rules.affected: Ubuntu Fontconfig 2.15.0 and Pango 1.52.1 X11 layout cache
rules.justification: The consumer is the named Pango layout API and the rule does not match metrics-only or API-lifecycle scenarios.
rules.reproducer: linux/tests/ibus-focus-reproducer.c calls pango_layout_get_size directly without Ghostty; the X11 product interaction can also produce this cache.

rules.rule_name: GTK Pango Fontconfig layout cache children
rules.affected: Ubuntu Fontconfig 2.15.0 indirect calloc children of the X11 Pango layout cache
rules.justification: The rule includes the Pango layout consumer and is rejected if the root is absent in the same report.
rules.reproducer: The standalone GTK/IBus reproducer deliberately sizes a Pango layout and records this child only beside the layout root.

rules.affected: Ubuntu GTK 4.14.5 IBus module and libibus 1.5.29 on the live Xwayland desktop
rules.finding_type: Memcheck:Leak definite/indirect IBusText preedit objects after focus-out
rules.justification: A standalone GtkIMMulticontext reproducer creates the same IBusText roots without Ghostty. This establishes external reproducibility but does not eliminate Ghostty lifecycle responsibility; that uncertainty remains documented.
rules.reproducer: GDK_BACKEND=x11 GTK_IM_MODULE=ibus linux/tests/ibus-focus-memory; raw stacks terminate in advance_focus in ibus-focus-reproducer.c rather than Surface.updateFocus.

rules.affected: Ubuntu GTK 4.14.5 IBus module/libibus 1.5.29 empty preedit strings
rules.finding_type: Memcheck:Leak indirect g_strdup child of IBusText
rules.justification: The full stack includes g_strdup, ibus_text_new_from_string, and the external GTK IBus module; it must co-occur with the IBusText root.
rules.reproducer: The standalone GTK/IBus raw receipt records the same one-byte strings without linking or loading Ghostty.
